deviations.details: The completed run used 10-second target sampling checked on the 2-second status-poll loop. Measured intervals ranged from 10.010 to 16.330 seconds. Peak observed RSS was 1,120,511,144 bytes, far below the 34,359,738,368-byte cap. The runner now samples on an independent 10-second schedule. No classifier run was repeated.

rss_sampling.deviation: The 2-second status polling loop and backend request time caused gaps above the requested 10 seconds. Maximum observed interval was 16.330 seconds. The runner now uses an independent periodic sampler; completed inference was not repeated.
